messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: PD#9876 — usage-ingest downstream lag detected for billing pipeline. Alert: token_count_delta > 25% for > 10m across 3 shards. Severity: P1. Auto-page to oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.com/PD#9876
oncall_ryan: acked — I’m on it, pulling logs now. Can someone confirm whether this correlates with the reconcile job spike we saw earlier?
sara: saw alert in monitoring too, queue lag jumped at 14:23 UTC. Consumer lag, not producer. I think the consumer group fell behind.
miguel: digging into consumer logs — getting repeated timeouts to ledger-write service: `java.net.SocketTimeoutException read timed out` from consumer-processor-3.
eng-nina: adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/usage-ingest-lag. steps 1-3. If consumer is flapping, restart and monitor checkpoint lag.
oncall_ryan: running `kubectl -n ingest rollout restart deployment/consumer-processor` on cluster-prod-3 now. Posting logs after restart.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: PD#9876 — acknowledged by oncall_ryan at 2026-03-14T14:35:10Z.
eng-nina: after restart, consumer-3 restarted cleanly but checkpoint lag still ~4k messages. Looks like some messages are being tombstoned in DLQ processing.
miguel: found 2k messages with bad schema causing processor to drop and ack. Sample payload: `{"customer_id":"sub_42","tokens":null,"event_type":"usage"}` — tokens null causes parse error downstream. We need a fail-safe for malformed events or to reprocess with sanitizer.
oncall_ryan: OK — mitigation path: (1) pause automatic invoice generation for impacted customers, (2) run a targeted reprocess for messages with schema errors after adding sanitizer, (3) escalate to billing-sre if ledger/write conflicts exist.
pm_lina: FYI support ticket #4321 from "AcmeCorp" reporting missing invoice line items for March. This looks related — potentially customer-facing. Please classify impact and timeline.
billing-sre: joining. On my way to check ledger sync and invoice job queues. If tokens are missing, invoice calc will undercount usage. We should hold invoice issuance until counts reconciled.
miguel: quick fix: pushing a hotspot sanitizer that maps null tokens -> 0 and tags event `sanitized: true`. Will push to canary set first.
sara: canary looks good on shard-1, token deltas for canary subset reconcile. But still need to ensure no double-counting on reprocess. Add idempotency keys.
oncall_ryan: coordinated plan and owners: restart consumer (done) — miguel; sanitizer canary + reprocess — miguel + eng-nina; pause invoice issuance — billing-sre; customer comms draft — pm_lina.
incident-bot: PD#9876 escalated to L2 after 12m of ack without resolution. Escalation: paging billing-sre.
billing-sre: Confirmed ledger writes are healthy; no conflicts, but invoice-runner has 18k pending jobs in `pending_reconcile` queue. Holding invoice-runner cron.
pm_lina: Drafting email to impacted customers: short note that we detected an ingestion issue affecting a subset of invoices, we are reconciling and will send corrected invoices within 48 hours. Tagging legal for SLA effects.
eng-nina: reprocess script ready. Command: ```python reprocess.py --from-ts 2026-03-14T14:00:00Z --to-ts 2026-03-14T15:00:00Z --filter malformed --idempotent``` Running on spot-repair pool with rate limit 200/s to avoid overloading ledger.
miguel: reprocess started on shard-1 and shard-2. Progress: 800/2000 events processed, reconcile delta +1200 tokens. Monitoring ledger commit latency.
oncall_ryan: alert: invoice hold needs ops approval for >24h. Billing-sre, can you confirm if we can safely delay invoices for impacted customers for up to 48 hours?
billing-sre: confirmed with ops — 48h max acceptable for manual hold. Logging decision in incident tracker.
pm_lina: please capture list of impacted customers (ids) so CS can proactively reach out. Support ticket list attached: https://redwood.internal/support/filters?tag=invoice-mismatch
sara: checkpoint lag back down to ~200 after reprocess started. Consumer healthy. Nice work.
miguel: reprocess finished for shard-1/2/3: reconciled 17,432 tokens across 53 customers. Running consistency checks against billing ledger now.
billing-sre: consistency checks: 52/53 customers matched expected totals after reprocess. One customer (sub_99) still shows a -300 token delta; investigating transaction ordering for that account.
oncall_ryan: handing off to night oncall: sara — I'll update PD and post hangover notes. Sara, take the bridge for any regressions.
sara: taking over. I’ll keep watch for 2 h, then rotate to next oncall. Leaving invoice hold in place.
pm_lina: customer comms sent to impacted customers and support queue updated. Tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2352467899.
incident-bot: PD#9876 — resolved by oncall_ryan at 2026-03-14T16:02:09Z (investigation complete, reprocess done, hold placed, follow-up tasks assigned).
billing-sre: follow-ups: add sanitizer to ingestion pipeline permanently, add schema validation metric, and add an automated reconciliation run post-restart. Filing ticket: INT-5678.
eng-nina: runbook update PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/912 — adds null-token handling and reprocess steps.
sara: thanks team — leaving notes in the channel and closing our bridge. If anything reappears, please ping me or reopen PD. :white_check_mark: 
oncall_ryan: thx all, nice triage. (reaction :thumbsup:)
